after_expected_public_metadata.description:
UNCERTIFIED — no hash-bound Viridis Comparator certificate covers this deposit's claims. Lean sources may compile but have not been independently certified. Results are conditional on the stated model assumptions.

Historical description:

Standalone record of the Viridis Canon (Intelligence Exergy). The core Intelligence-Bound canon spine is unchanged (frozen at v10.1.0 “The Keystone Wave”, record 21223021); this record links to the spine via isDerivedFrom the concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19317982.

Classical exergy analysis decomposes a thermodynamic system's available work into useful work and destroyed availability, related by the Gouy–Stodola theorem (destroyed exergy = ambient temperature × entropy generation). The Intelligence Exergy Theorem (IET) ports this machinery to cognition: a channel's information capacity decomposes into exergy (useful predictive information) and anergy (destroyed capacity), and a cognitive analogue of the Gouy–Stodola relation holds exactly, with the Intelligence-Bound constant c = D/(k_B T ln 2) playing the role of the thermodynamic conversion factor.

Six results are machine-checked in Lean 4 (Aristotle, zero sorry, axioms ⊆ {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}), module IntelligenceExergy.lean: (i) capacity_exergy_decomposition_nonneg — capacity decomposes into nonnegative exergy and anergy; (ii) exergy_eq_predictive_info — exergy equals predictive information exactly; (iii) cognitive_gouy_stodola — the cognitive Gouy–Stodola relation, with a strict zero-destruction dichotomy; (iv) second_law_efficiency_eq_cos2theta — second-law efficiency bounded in [0,1] via Cauchy–Schwarz; (v) exergy_superadditive_under_coupling — coupling two cognitive systems is exergy-superadditive, with equality iff the systems match; (vi) iet_nonvacuous — an explicit interior witness.

One benign, non-weakening fix during proving: a let-bound local name using the reserved Unicode token Σ (illegal as a Lean 4 identifier head) was alpha-renamed; the elaborated conclusion is unchanged.

Scope. The Lean proofs certify the validity of the reasoning, not empirical magnitudes. Working paper; not peer-reviewed.
after_expected_public_metadata.notes: Viridis Canon, standalone record (NEW category: Intelligence Exergy). Routed standalone from nightly Run-088 (2026-07-03); ledger row 44. Spine unchanged (frozen at v10.1.0, record 21223021, 'The Keystone Wave'); this record links to the spine only via isDerivedFrom the concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19317982 and references the current spine head. Lean 4 proofs (Aristotle project 74cc2352-6ede-4035-b107-ca61ad2e9e98, all 6 sorry discharged, zero sorry, toolchain leanprover/lean4:v4.28.0, Mathlib pin 8f9d9cff) certify the analytic core of IET, module IntelligenceExergy.lean. The six verified theorems, statements preserved verbatim: (1) capacity_exergy_decomposition_nonneg -- a cognitive channel's capacity decomposes into nonnegative exergy (useful predictive work) and anergy (destroyed capacity) components; (2) exergy_eq_predictive_info -- exergy equals predictive information exactly, and anergy is nonnegative because E <= C*mu, with exergy plus anergy summing to the total capacity; (3) cognitive_gouy_stodola -- a Gouy-Stodola-form relation: the destroyed exergy equals temperature times entropy generation rate, T*sigma_gen = Xi_dest, with a strict dichotomy F=0 iff Xi_dest=0 where c = D/(kB*T*ln2) > 0; (4) second_law_efficiency_eq_cos2theta -- second-law efficiency is bounded in [0,1] via a discrete Cauchy-Schwarz inequality; (5) exergy_superadditive_under_coupling -- coupling two cognitive systems produces superadditive exergy, kappa*(tA-tB)^2 >= 0, with equality iff the systems' temperatures/rates coincide; (6) iet_nonvacuous -- an explicit interior witness confirming all conclusions are non-vacuous (efficiency value 1/2 attained). One flagged, non-weakening change: in the T3 statement a let-bound local name using the reserved Unicode token Sigma (which cannot begin a Lean 4 identifier) was alpha-renamed to sigma_gen; the elaborated conclusion Xi_dest = T * sigma_gen is mathematically identical to the originally intended statement -- no hypothesis dropped, no conclusion collapsed. Every named theorem is genuine and non-vacuous (T6 exhibits an explicit interior witness binding T1-T5). The Lean proofs certify the validity of the reasoning, not empirical magnitudes. Working paper; not peer-reviewed.
